name: paperlint
description: Lint LaTeX papers against a house style

paperlint.path.description: Executable used to run paperlint. Use an absolute path if it is not on PATH.

paperlint.args.description: Arguments placed before the TeX file. Example: ["-m", "paperlint"] with paperlint.path set to python3.

paperlint.root.description: Root .tex file to lint. A relative path is resolved from the workspace folder. Empty uses a % !TEX root comment, then the active file.

paperlint.run.description: When to lint. onType also lints on save.
